t_advice_summary_textbox.text: First trial and error. Start noticing patterns in the colours. Use the 1x multipliers to experiment if unsure.

vb_textbox.text: I began with trial and error and built up a few colours that I felt were high scoring. This only lasted for a short time and then they began giving 0 points. I found the 1x multiplier easier to risk and play around with different colours. After the break, any patterns you observe seem to change and sometimes the opposite is true. In some rounds I felt as though some colours were impacted by the colour they were paired with e.g. purple scored high when with green but then scored lower when paired with yellow.
